## D2C Calculators: ROAS, CAC, LTV and Unit Economics

URL: https://www.mondaymarketing.company/tools/
Description: Free calculators and a plain-English glossary for D2C marketing: break-even ROAS, funnel ROAS, unit economics, CAC runway, growth trajectory and LTV:CAC.
Answer: MMC's free tools are calculators and a glossary that help a D2C brand work out what a customer can cost, where the funnel leaks, and how long profit takes. They cover unit economics, break-even ROAS, funnel ROAS, LTV:CAC and CAC runway. There is no email wall or sign-up, and your own numbers decide the answer. There is no email wall and no sign-up. Put your numbers in and take the answer with you.
